## 🔧 Type of Change

## ✅ Testing Checklist

- [ ] Tested in **Chrome** (latest)
- [ ] Tested in **Firefox** (latest)
- [ ] Tested in **Safari** (if applicable)
- [ ] Tested on **mobile / small screen**
- [ ] **Dark mode** looks correct
- [ ] **Light mode** looks correct
- [ ] No browser console errors
- [ ] Unit tests pass (`npm test`)
- [ ] Existing functionality not broken

## 📋 Code Quality Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the [style guide](CONTRIBUTING.md#coding-standards)
- [ ] JSDoc comments added for new public functions
- [ ] No debug `console.log` statements left in code
- [ ] Variables and functions have descriptive names
- [ ] CSS uses design system variables (no hardcoded colors)

## 📚 Documentation Checklist

- [ ] README updated (if feature changes user-facing behavior)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md entry added under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] Code is self-documenting or has inline comments for complex logic
